title: Underground piping, irrigation and drainage
requirements: Five years, 9,000 hours; age 18+; physically demanding work and supervision by a journeyman.
action: Apply for the applicant pool online or visit the Duarte office. Selection and employment are not guaranteed.
pay: Paid apprenticeship, exact current pay: confirm with program
work: Irrigation, underground piping, storm drains, site work and welding-related processes.

title: Plumber or steamfitter
requirements: Age 18+, high school diploma or GED, identification; driver license required at acceptance. Five-year training and physical duties.
action: Call (909) 945-5557 for an application appointment. Training is in El Monte; applications handled in Rancho Cucamonga.
pay: Apprentice wage scale: confirm with sponsor
work: Plumbing, steam systems, pipe assembly, repair and field installations.

title: Sheet metal and HVAC fabrication
requirements: Age 18+; timed mathematics and written tests. Diploma or GED recommended, not mandatory per program website.
action: Application opens December 7, 2026 at 6:00 a.m. PST and may close as soon as its cap is reached.
work: Shop fabrication, ductwork, welding-related processes, installation and HVAC systems.

title: Inside wireman electrician
requirements: Online application with documentation and aptitude-testing process. Review the trade-specific mathematics, age and education requirements.
action: 2026 application windows are closed. Monitor the official calendar for the next window. Commerce training site is outside central LA.
work: Electrical installation, troubleshooting and commercial construction.

title: Low-voltage sound and communications installer
requirements: Three-year apprenticeship with required application documents and aptitude testing.
action: Review official instructions and the next scheduled application window.
work: Cabling, networking infrastructure, fire alarm and low-voltage systems.

title: Fire sprinkler fitter
requirements: Age 18+; high school diploma or GED; written and oral exams. Program listed as 60 months.
action: Call sponsor at (562) 907-7622 and check the official program calendar before visiting.
pay: State record lists a starting wage, verify current rate
work: Install and service fire suppression piping in buildings.

title: Elevator constructor and technician
requirements: Applicants take the EIAT covering arithmetic, reading, mechanical reasoning and tools, then interview if eligible.
action: Request a NEIEP notification. Local 18 Los Angeles / San Diego recruitment is not currently open; July 2027 is tentative.
work: Elevator installation, mechanical maintenance and electrical systems.

title: Structural ironworker and welder
requirements: Age 18+, high school diploma, GED or accepted equivalent; physical ability. Application is in person.
action: Contact the training center about intake and eligibility. Applicant pool entry is not a job offer.
pay: State record lists a starting wage, verify current rate
work: Steel framing, erection, rigging, welding and elevated work.

title: Reinforcing ironworker
requirements: Age 18+, high school diploma or GED; four-year program. Physically demanding work.
action: Contact the joint training program to confirm the next intake and current wages.
work: Rebar installation and reinforcement of concrete structures.

title: Heavy equipment operator or mechanic
requirements: Mechanical aptitude, safety training, reliable transport, and requirements set by the training trust.
action: Ask the Whittier training facility about current apprenticeship applications and testing.
work: Operate, inspect, maintain or weld heavy construction machinery.

title: Commercial plumber
requirements: Age 18+, US high school diploma or GED, California driver license and required identity documents.
action: Official application appointments are in central Los Angeles. Confirm the location and whether extensive travel is workable.
pay: Paid apprenticeship; rate varies by year
work: Plumbing, piping systems, testing and maintenance.

title: Commercial carpenter and millwork installer
requirements: Training sponsors vary by craft. Ask about apprentice entry, ability to work on jobsites, and physical requirements.
action: Contact local union training representatives, verify official program intake and placement requirements.
work: Framing, finish carpentry, millwork and construction projects.

title: Steamfitter and welding specialist
requirements: Five-year pipe trades apprenticeship typically combines mathematics, mechanical aptitude and on-the-job training. Verify current requirements.
action: Contact the union training office in Gardena. This route may require regular travel outside the SGV.
work: Welding, fitting, steam systems, HVAC piping and industrial work.

title: Utility electrical linework
requirements: Utility roles may require a commercial driver license, climbing and field safety training, and program-specific requirements.
action: Check the official apprenticeship and job dispatch requirements. Dispatch calls are not open applications for every visitor.
work: Outdoor electrical power distribution and utility infrastructure.

title: Painter, drywall finisher and wall covering
requirements: Program requirements vary. Ask about apprenticeship enrollment, physical work and safety training.
action: Contact the union training program to verify the relevant trade and recruitment availability.
work: Surface preparation, painting, finishing and commercial jobsite work.

title: Architectural glass installer and glazier
requirements: Glass handling and construction safety are important. Verify program credentials and training requirements.
action: Ask District Council 36 about current glazier training options.

title: Carpenter, equipment operator or cement mason
requirements: Age 18+, diploma or GED, transportation and physical ability; drug screening possible.
action: Check Riverside and Orange County training-center availability. An application does not guarantee a job.
work: Carpentry, heavy equipment, cement masonry, labor and finishing.

title: Explore all state-registered apprenticeships
requirements: Trade-specific requirements differ. Verify registration, wages, application periods and sponsor contacts.
action: Search official programs by county and occupation to find additional openings not on commercial job boards.
pay: Compare official wage and benefit information
work: Use the official state database to expand beyond the curated union list.
